publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4 / 4A102 and 3.1.3 / 7E18; native PinePhone execution, distinct QEMU gates and offline next-target study
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: 10B500 stops at a real clock-gate dependency
record.method: Diskless guest with actual QOM press/release stimuli and stock dispatch trace
record.observation: The isolated 3GS 10B500 experiment reaches CPUIdle setup and genuine two-input stock keyboard dispatch, then panics on absent function-clock_gate.
record.limits: No authentic normal Darwin banner, root storage, launchd, UI, stock reset or physical execution is accepted. Two inputs are not the full five-input GPIO contract; client delivery remains unproven.
